nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) (2.62 GB)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) (577.2 MB)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) (14.61 GB)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) (1.82 GB)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is Han Li, already visible in the opening Latent Guide; <Picture 1> calibrates his established face, hairstyle, build, and clothing for this segment.

<Subject 2> is Mo Daifu, already visible in the opening Latent Guide; <Picture 2> calibrates his established face, hair, hands, and robe for this segment.

<Subject 3> is the pharmacy inner room, already present in the opening Latent Guide; <Picture 3> calibrates its established layout, furniture, and lighting for this segment.

<Picture 4> is the low-angle framing and body-torque anchor for [Shot 4], defining <Subject 2>'s half-risen snarl and the upward camera angle; it does not define the sound wave, which in this segment is a semi-transparent cold-white pressure ring, not golden runes.

<Picture 5> is the stance anchor for <Subject 2>'s palm strike in [Shot 4], defining the dropped shoulder, drawn-back left palm, and back-foot weight; it does not define any projected air blade — the strike is contact only.

summary:

[video continuation + reference generation] The target video continues from the final frame of the preceding segment: <Subject 2> clamps down on <Subject 1>'s wrist inside <Subject 3>, the boy cannot pull free, the old man's smile breaks into a snarl, one shout and one contact palm strike hurl him to the floor as cold-white pressure rings burst outward, and his falling short sword topples the herb grinder; the old man then leans over him in silence. <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> calibrate the two characters, <Picture 3> the room, <Picture 4> the low-angle shout staging, and <Picture 5> the palm-strike stance.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - identity inherited from the opening Latent Guide; <Picture 1> calibrates.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - identity inherited from the opening Latent Guide; <Picture 2> calibrates.

<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - identity inherited from the opening Latent Guide; <Picture 3> calibrates.

<Picture 4> ([Shot 4] framing and pose): fully_preserved - the upward angle, half-risen torque, and snarling face are reproduced; the sound wave is not taken from the image.

<Picture 5> ([Shot 4] strike stance): fully_preserved - the dropped shoulder, drawn-back palm, and back-foot weight are reproduced; no air blade is taken from the image.

detailed_description:

The target video is a Chinese guofeng 3D cinematic realistic render, lit by one oil lamp and one blade of daylight; apart from the shout's cold-white pressure rings, all motion is physical.

[Shot 1] The camera holds the preceding segment's frontal symmetrical two-shot [pressure]: <Subject 2> seated at frame-right, right hand clamped on <Subject 1>'s right wrist across the armrest, his smile held, eyes on the boy, the wrist skin whitened; <Subject 1> stands at frame-left, left thumb on his sword guard. The lamp and the daylight band hold still. At 00:02.000, without a cut, the thumb grinds into the pulse-point and the hand wrenches half a turn; the forearm jerks taut, the wrist twists and cannot pull free. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed onto the locked wrist [pressure]. [2.9s] The chair creaks.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.300, the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed into a tight close-up of <Subject 1>'s face [reveal]. His eyes drop to the clamped wrist, then snap up to the old man; the calm drains out, his pupils shrink, his breath stops. His left hand locks white-knuckled on the hilt, his shoulder pulls back, but he does not step away.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed onto <Subject 2>'s mouth and eyes [reveal]. The smile collapses; the creases drag outward, lips peeling into a snarl as he draws a long breath. His eyes go flat and cold, and his grip tightens again.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.300, the camera cuts to a low-angle side medium close-up after <Picture 4>, then shakes strongly as the shout lands [lead]. <Subject 2> half-rises into the stance of <Picture 5>, right hand locked on the wrist, left palm drawn back. <Subject 2> (S1) shouts in a cracked, explosive voice, <d>[中文] 呔！</d> Cold-white pressure rings burst from mouth and chest: a bright main ring and two fainter outer rings, semi-transparent and misty, bright-edged with faint refraction, expanding fast. Dust sheets off the bricks, drawers rattle, the herb grinder jolts, the lamp flame flattens and gutters. The rings strike <Subject 1>: tunic pressed to his chest, hair blown back, torso jolted, knees buckling, the left hand sliding off the hilt. <Subject 2>'s left palm drives into his sternum, contact only; the right hand tears free and the boy is hurled back.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.300, the camera tracks the thrown boy down with large amplitude at fast speed into a low angle [lead], then pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. <Subject 1> hits the bricks inside the daylight band, slides, settles on his back. His sheathed short sword tears loose, clatters into the herb grinder by the door; it topples, powder spilling. <Subject 2> rises, crosses, and lowers himself over him. A side medium close-up: the boy's unfocused face lower left, the old man above at right, close to his ear, smiling without his eyes. No word comes; his two fingers press slowly together above the boy's chest and stop. The lamp steadies; the frame holds.

overall_soundscape:

A low brick-room tone with the door draft hissing at the half-open panel and a thin window-paper hum beneath; the oil lamp crackles, dry fingertips rasp on skin, and the rosewood chair creaks under the old man's weight. The shout lands as a concussive air boom; the pressure rings wash outward with a hollow whoosh and a dust hiss, cabinet drawers ring on their runners, the iron bell knocks the beam, the door hinge groans, and the lamp flame flutters hard. A heavy palm impact and snapping cloth, a body hitting the bricks and sliding, a sheathed sword clattering into the stone grinder, the grinder toppling with grit spilling, then cloth shoes crossing the bricks and settling dust. The room falls quiet and stays quiet.

non_diegetic_music:

A low sustained bowed-string drone at a slow tempo over a heartbeat-like frame-drum pulse that tightens through the grip and stops dead on the shout. One deep struck drum lands with the pressure rings; a thin high string harmonic stretches over the body's fall and thins to a near-silent sustained tone under the close hold.
